content.short: Ridotto is the very first cross-chain gambling & lottery protocol.
content.description:
Ridotto is the first cross-chain gambling and lottery protocol based on complete transparency, anonymity, security, and fairness. Our approach is to provide an open protocol, driven by the community, where users can play or build games and earn rewards by providing liquidity to the DeFi ecosystem. On top of the protocol, we developed the Ridotto platform. An easy-to-use and user-friendly app that offers a genuine and vibrant gambling experience. To provide full transparency, the Ridotto protocol runs over multiple smart contracts on decentralized blockchains. Both players and liquidity providers get access to the winning rate, probabilities, and all other aspects hidden by traditional casino operators. Ridotto is designed to be a cross-chain protocol to optimize smart contracts costs and transactions fees. The protocol's unique approach is in how it provides an efficient user experience. The protocol enables users to develop unique games on its platform using the Ridotto Lab. It offers robust tools, SDKs, libraries and the integration of extra layers as oracles. Ridotto is community-driven. As a token holder, you will play a critical role in each evolution, proposal, decision, and everything in between. We will work together and combine our ideas to generate the best outcome. Ridotto’s platform is an all-in-one app that provides a vibrant and entertaining gaming experience. Its streamlined interface gives users easy access to their favorite games, pools and wallet. Ridotto deviates from the traditional “the house always wins” approach by bringing users into the fold. Users can earn rewards by staking and providing liquidity to the Ridotto protocol. This approach provides users with the possibility of becoming the house. A custom home for each player with an overview of earnings, favorite games, and suggestions matching preferences and playing history. A large and diversified game catalog with four main categories: Cards and table games, bets, slots, and lottery.We provide fully transparent data for each game, including winning rate and user feedback. By providing liquidity to Ridotto DeFi protocol, players become the house. The pools are associated with the games and have different APR and risk exposure. Special event games with a random reward such as APR cards multiplier, NFTs, BTC jackpots. Track your assets and earnings by using a non-custodial wallet. Ridotto provides a cross-chain abstraction layer, tools, oracle integration and SDKs for quick game releases.
